title: Ship's moved-head refusal fixture is a real gh capture
body:
Source: lane report for #1160 (04e6b9e, t-b2xz7gd): test/ci/ship.test.ts matches gh's moved-head refusal as "Head branch was modified" from memory; it was never captured from a real `gh pr merge --match-head-commit` refusal (KRN-12).
Outcome: the moved-head fixture in test/ci/ship.test.ts is a verbatim capture of real gh stderr (file under test/fixtures/ with the gh version), and ship maps it to exit 77.
Why: a wrong guess turns a moved head into a generic failure instead of 77, and lanes retry the wrong way.
Proof: the fixture file names the gh version and the command that produced it; the ship test reading it gets exit 77.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts, test/fixtures/
